answer: The ivory I would price into every new account is Gem cutter faceted gem mark witnessed by the bead record: each faceted gem is a wax seal pressed beside the cutters mark, so a farm must cut a hundred real gems by hand, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the nectar for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The lantern is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
